text:
A TurtleBot 4 and a MyCobot 280 share logistics tasks
in a didactic Siemens smart factory. The system links
robot navigation, vision and manipulation through
open-source software, using only onboard sensors.

text:
Robot platforms and factory PLCs use different
software stacks. Reliable operation requires explicit
coordination across ROS 2 Jazzy, ROS 2 Galactic
and the Siemens industrial network.

name: Modular approach body
text:
Separate interfaces connect the mobile base,
manipulator and OPC UA factory gateway.
The dashboard supervises shared missions,
while each robot can also run independently.

name: Delivery mission body
text:
Collect the identified product,
deliver it to the destination for
its colour and return to dock.
textPreview: Collect the identified product, | deliver it to the destination for | its colour and return to dock.

name: Retrieval mission body
text:
Collect rejected components
from the factory and transport
them to the inspection area.
textPreview: Collect rejected components | from the factory and transport | them to the inspection area.

name: Restock mission body
text:
Collect supplies and bring them
to the factory inventory station
before returning to dock.
textPreview: Collect supplies and bring them | to the factory inventory station | before returning to dock.

name: Evaluation body
text:
The next benchmark covers clear paths,
static obstacles and moving obstacles.
ROS bag recordings capture robot motion
and mission events for cycle-time and
completion-rate analysis.
